blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Port Coquitlam condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for apartments (condos) in Port Coquitlam was $550,000 in September 2026 (-9.0% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Port Coquitlam condos sold, November 2025 to October 2026

202 condos sold in Port Coquitlam with a median price of $557,500 (the middle half sold between $465,625 and $628,375), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $614 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $431 a month.

items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: What did condos in Port Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 202 condos sold in Port Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $557,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.6% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Port Coquitlam sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 202 condos that sold in Port Coquitlam went for between $465,625 and $628,375, around a median of $557,500.

faq.q: Do condos in Port Coquitlam sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 202 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.6% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Of the 202 sales, 202 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $431.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median year built was 2008 for the 202 condos sold in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Port Coquitlam usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Port Coquitlam had 2 bedrooms, from the 202 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Coquitlam communities sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Central Pt Coquitlam (152), Glenwood PQ (45), Riverwood (5), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Coquitlam buildings sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Montrose Square (13), Villagio Ii (5), The Crescent (5), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in Port Coquitlam was $550,000 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 9.0%. Over three months it fell 5.6%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Port Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Port Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 24%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in Port Coquitlam that match what you want.
